extra_note_33: 33 Übungslift Salvista: the practice slope beside the Salvista T-bar at Itter (lift 33 on the 2025-26 map). It was drawn by hand 35 m beside the lift until OpenStreetMap mapped it (way 1246174319, no name, 17 m from the hand-drawn line); since 2026-11-23 that way carries the name and the hand-drawn copy is gone.
include_ways_note: Lifts outside the OpenStreetMap outline that belong to the resort (found by tools/whole_check.py, 2026-11-21).
two_way_lifts_note: Sonnenband: a flat beginner conveyor, usable both ways.
shared_runs_note: Verbindung Osthang Berg -Südhang was drawn 5-12 m beside Südhang - Abfahrt II for almost its whole length (two OpenStreetMap ways on one slope, neither name on the resort's list): drawn once (2026-11-23).
